description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling the DeletePolicy command within a policy persistence context. It processes delete requests, generates corresponding events, and manages entity tags.

classes.name: DeletePolicyStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the deletion of policies by processing DeletePolicy commands, generating PolicyDeleted events, and managing entity tags.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete policy command by creating a PolicyDeleted event, preparing the response with optional ETag headers, and returning a result object.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag of the previous policy entity, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional as no next entity tag is associated with delete operations.
